prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object found, move and grab it. Then check properties and complete task. Otherwise, scan or move.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = GrabObject    />     <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Action ID = MoveToNextArea    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectWithinReach    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectFound    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectFound? THEN
			SEQUENCE
				DO MoveToObject
					IF IsObjectWithinReach? THEN
					DO GrabObject
			END
	ELSE
		DO CheckObject
		DO SpecificTask
	END
